## **Pricing and paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Pricing and paywall.**
      5 recent review(s) mention pricing and paywall.
      Review window: Sep 1, 2026 - Sep 8, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention price, subscriptions, or paywalls. This can signal pricing sensitivity in the niche.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Lynette Rogers_, Sep 8, 2026, 1/5: "very poor quality app, regularly doesn't record the days workout meaning I can't progress to the next day. The lack of warning that a subscription amount will be taken out is also frustrating. Avoid signing up."
            2. _Shelley Raulerson_, Sep 5, 2026, 1/5: "Signed up for the cheap trial, never used it. Then came the subscription chg of $30.51. Opened the app to cancel and also explained that I had never used it and asked for a refund. The responses came from Nancy, but at the bottom it says they are AI generated. Who knows if you're talking to a real person or not. By the end of me repeatedly asking for a refund, and her saying no bc of the terms/conditions and giving me 4 months free with other useless stuff, I'm not happy. Customer svc is trash."
            3. _Patricia LeVay_, Sep 8, 2026, 2/5: "too expensive. had to cancel my subscriptiom."

## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

   **Bugs and stability.**
      1 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Jun 13, 2026 - Aug 25, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Mel_, Jun 13, 2026, 1/5: "Full application bug. Attempt to withdraw a second amount without my authorization of more than 60 euros. beware. but the worst is only 2 months later. he still tries to steal amounts between 50 and 60 euros from you. No expiry date, I blocked the card. to flee"
            2. _Patricia Bliss_, Aug 25, 2026, 5/5: "At 70, I have lower back, hip & knee issues, I find Tai Chi Chair doable, even while feeling fragile. I also lost 3 pounds just in the first 10 days. Way better than Tai Chi Walking, which I tried first, and ended up hurting in all the above areas after the first session. Tai Chi Chair has not caused any pain, so I can keep on doing the exercises."
